title: KATA institution keys
description: Key document an institution publishes at https://<domain>/.well-known/kata-keys.json. KATA also keeps an allowlist. A rotated key stays trusted until not_after plus the grace period. The default grace is 7 days. Status: framework note.

domain.description: Host that publishes this document. Optional on a record inside the document itself.

not_after.description: End of the key's validity. Trust continues through the grace period after this instant.
